children: bioAffinity Technologies will present two posters showing clinical and veteran-focused data for its noninvasive CyPath Lung test at NAVREF 2026.
Presenting two posters at NAVREF Annual Conference Sept 27-30 on CyPath Lung's clinical use and veteran/military research.
Poster 1: case series showing CyPath Lung aided diagnosis, guided discussions and avoided unnecessary invasive procedures.
Poster 2: ongoing FlowPath Lung 2,000-patient longitudinal study in veterans/military, currently enrolling across VA and military centers.
Study emphasizes at-home sputum collection and cites prior results: 92% sensitivity, 87% specificity, 99% NPV for nodules ≤20 mm.
